name: stock-research-skills
description: 19 read-only skills for Indian market research over Groww's MCP server — portfolio planning, portfolio review, stock/mutual fund/bond analysis, earnings and corporate-action tracking, SIP review, F&O, and tax estimates. Never places, modifies, or cancels an order.

interface.shortDescription: Read-only Indian market research over Groww
interface.longDescription: A research desk for Indian markets: review your real portfolio, analyse stocks, mutual funds and bonds, track earnings, corporate actions, SIPs and rate moves, and estimate capital gains — all read-only over Groww's MCP server. Every recommendation states its horizon, its numeric basis, its specific invalidators, and whether you already hold the instrument. It never places, modifies, or cancels an order.
defaultPrompt: What do you think about this stock at current levels?
Which of my holdings report results this month?
